title: TallyPrime AI agent: reminders, sheets, reports | 50agents
description: Tell Captain the job and a TallyPrime AI agent does it: payment reminders on WhatsApp, sales and purchases in Google Sheets, statements to your accountant.
h1: An AI agent for TallyPrime that chases dues and logs your vouchers
answer: With 50agents, a TallyPrime AI agent sends payment reminders, logs sales and purchase vouchers in Google Sheets, alerts your team on Slack and emails statements to your accountant, across the 2,300+ apps your business already uses.
You describe the job to Captain in one sentence, check the plan it shows, and it runs on its own whenever TallyPrime records the event.
asks: When TallyPrime shows a payment due, send that customer a polite WhatsApp reminder with the amount
Add every new sales voucher over Rs 50,000 to my Sales sheet and tell me on Slack
Email my accountant every account statement TallyPrime exports, with a one-line summary
Every Monday, tell me on WhatsApp if no purchase was recorded in TallyPrime last week

faqs.q: Can an AI agent read my TallyPrime data?
faqs.a: 50agents reacts to TallyPrime events such as “New Sales event occurs”, “New Receipt event occurs” and “New Payment Due Reminder”, then an AI agent reads that voucher and writes the message or summary. For free-form questions over all your books, use a connector made for that. It needs extra setup and your IT person.

faqs.q: How do I connect automation to TallyPrime?
faqs.a: Tools usually talk to Tally through its HTTP XML server on port 9000, which needs the Tally company open and, for outside access, a static IP or VPN. In 50agents you pick the TallyPrime events when you connect it, and Captain builds the steps after that.

faqs.q: Can it send payment reminders from TallyPrime?
faqs.a: Yes. “New Payment Due Reminder” starts the job, and an AI agent writes a polite reminder with the party, amount and invoice, then sends it on WhatsApp or Gmail. You can ask Captain to wait for your approval first.

faqs.q: Can I get every sale or purchase into Google Sheets?
faqs.a: Yes. “New Sales event occurs” and “New Purchase event occurs” each add a row when a voucher is created, updated, deleted or saved as PDF. Say in the ask which of those you want, for example only new vouchers.

faqs.q: Does it file my GST return?
faqs.a: No. It collects sales and purchase vouchers in a sheet and can email them to your accountant, so GST checking is faster. Filing stays with you or your accountant on the GST portal.

faqs.q: Can I filter by voucher type or party?
faqs.a: Several triggers, such as “New Receipt event occurs”, “New Credit Note event occurs” and “New Sales Order event occurs”, let you choose voucher types, and “New Payment Due Reminder” can be filtered by company or customer. Say it in the ask.

faqs.q: Does it send messages to customers without asking me?
faqs.a: An automation's message waits in Needs you until you approve it, and an AI agent asks before sending until you allow it in Settings. You decide when it may send on its own.

faqs.q: Do I need to write code or build a flowchart?
faqs.a: No. You write the job in a sentence, Captain shows the plan in plain words, and you change any step by saying so.
